summary: Iteration 154 exhaustively validated RealmLife property authority (TEST B/C/D/E/F), presence chat, optimized GLB assets, and the frontend flows (desktop chat, landing skin-tone-only customization for Player 1/2, mobile POV toggle + chat button, in-game property panel guest-access controls). 10/10 backend pytest cases PASS. Frontend: desktop world builds, chat bubble 'Hey! 👋' renders above avatar in-game, property panel shows GUEST INTERIOR ACCESS with ALL LEVELS PUBLIC / ALL LEVELS PRIVATE / CUSTOM tri-state and per-level GROUND/SECOND/THIRD toggles, and PRIVATE persists across close/reopen (reset to PUBLIC at end). Mobile 390x844 shows 👁 POV (realmlife-mobile-pov-btn) left of HOME/MENU inside viewport, toggling to 🌐 WORLD; 💬 chat button opens compact input that does NOT cover the joystick; JUMP/INTERACT visible. Landing customization: Player 1 APPEARANCE tab shows ONLY 6 SKIN TONE swatches — HAIR STYLE / HAIR COLOR / EYE COLOR NOT rendered — CLOTHING and ACCESSORIES tabs NOT present in the top tab bar (only PLAYER, APPEARANCE, AVATARS), and clicking the darkest swatch highlights it (SAVE succeeds).

issues: Hero avatar mesh not visible on the neon platform during initial customization (only glow ring + 'drag to rotate' text). Skin swatch does highlight and SAVE works but the 3D preview character itself does not render in the platform for auditcheckreal in this run — possibly still loading the _game.glb via cachedLoadGLTF. Not a blocker; log for main agent to verify hero preview mount timing.

action_items: (Optional polish) Verify hero 3D avatar renders on landing platform on cold load — currently platform+ring show but character mesh not visible in screenshot. Skin recolor UI itself works.
(Optional) Add stable data-testid attributes to landing skin swatches (e.g. data-testid='realmlife-skin-swatch-N') to make automated regression more robust — currently found via style-based fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: property_access_check correctly returns level_access all-false when unauthorized regardless of mode, and all-true for household members regardless of mode. Symmetric denial verified (stealth denied on property-000002, audit denied on property-000001).
invite_guest immediately activates access (no accept step) — matches guest access-check reason='temporary_guest' behavior expected by review request TEST D.
evict_guest correctly marks access revoked; guest access-check flips allowed=false reason=private_property.
set_guest_interior_access validates mode in (public/private/custom); private returns all-false level_access to guests; custom respects levels payload.
Presence chat: 200-char cap enforced (250-char text truncated to 200); chat_text/chat_id/chat_ts included in others[] projection; response includes server_ts. All verified.
Optimized GLBs: 698bce...(~2.4MB) and 8787f2...(~2.2MB) served with 200 from /api/media/models/*_game.glb.
Founder home_anchor.founder=true with lot_seq=null and spawn (0, 17.6) confirmed; auditcheckreal home_anchor.lot_seq=2, x≈-104, and world/home spawn matches. No cross-account fallback observed.
RealmLifePropertyPanel exposes stable testids realmlife-guest-access-{public|private|custom} and realmlife-guest-level-{ground|second|third} — good; PRIVATE persists across panel close/reopen.
test_credentials: stealth / Password1$ (founder property-000001 lot 1), auditcheckreal / Password1$ (member property-000002 lot 2 x=-104), tftwo / pass1234 (throwaway guest — used for invite/evict/level-access cycle).

If tftwo is later removed, the guest fixture falls back to tfthree or registers a fresh tfguest_* user. Landing hero 3D preview character may not appear on cold load — worth revisiting.
